paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 2.55 as of October 23, with a change of -3.77% from the prior close and -43.96% over 22 sessions.

Recent news includes a shareholder letter from the CEO outlining a new financing approach for Project Matador, as reported by Yahoo Finance on October 24, and a report from MarketBeat on October 23 stating that the stock fell 3.8% following insider selling.

There have been recent filings, including 4 Form 4 filings and 3 Form 144 filings, with the most recent filings including an insider transaction report on October 22 and a notice of proposed sale on October 20, as well as an 8-K filing on October 16 regarding an amendment to the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement.
